result.instructions: Tools for Airbrake, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Airbrake data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run airbrake_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run airbrake_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run airbrake_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. airbrake_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: airbrake_list_projects
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: List the Airbrake projects your user can see, with id, name, last deploy, notice total, rejected count, deploy count and resolved/unresolved error-group counts. Start here to get a project_id. Airbrake API: GET /api/v4/projects.

tools.name: airbrake_get_project
tools.title: Get a project
tools.description: Get one Airbrake project: name, last deploy id/time, notice total, rejection count, deploy count and resolved/unresolved error-group counts. Airbrake API: GET /api/v4/projects/{project_id}.

tools.name: airbrake_list_groups
tools.title: List error groups
tools.description: List a project's error groups ("errors" in the Airbrake app): each with id, resolved flag, error type/message/backtrace, context (environment, severity, component/action), last notice time, notice counts and last deploy. Sorted by last notice by default; order by notice_count, weight or created instead. Filter by deploy, archived or muted groups, or creation time. Backtraces are cut to the first 5 frames (set full_backtraces for all; airbrake_get_group shows one group in full). Airbrake API: GET /api/v4/projects/{project_id}/groups.

start_time.description: Only groups created after this RFC 3339 date-time (with timezone).

end_time.description: Only groups created before this RFC 3339 date-time (with timezone).

full_backtraces.description: Return every backtrace frame (default: first 5 per error).

tools.name: airbrake_get_group
tools.title: Get an error group
tools.description: Get one error group in full: resolved flag, every error with its complete backtrace (file, function, line, column), context, last deploy, last notice id/time, notice counts and creation time. Airbrake API: GET /api/v4/projects/{project_id}/groups/{group_id}.

group_id.description: Error group id (digits, as a string: Airbrake group ids exceed JavaScript's safe integers). From airbrake_list_groups.

tools.name: airbrake_get_group_stats
tools.title: Get error group statistics
tools.description: Occurrence counts over time for one error group: parallel arrays `time`, `accepted` (notices counted) and `limited` (dropped by rate limits), aggregated per period, from `since` until `until` (default now). Use it to see whether an error is spiking or fading. Airbrake API: GET /api/v5/projects/{project_id}/groups/{group_id}/stats.

group_id.description: Error group id (digits, as a string: Airbrake group ids exceed JavaScript's safe integers). From airbrake_list_groups.

period.description: Aggregation period. The reference lists 1m, 5m, 15m, 30m, 2h, 3h, 6h, 12h, 24h (project stats) and minute, hour (group stats).

since.description: Start (inclusive), RFC 3339 date-time with timezone; sent as time__gte in Unix seconds.

until.description: End (exclusive, default now), RFC 3339 date-time with timezone; sent as time__lt.

tools.name: airbrake_list_notices
tools.title: List notices of an error group
tools.description: List the individual occurrences (notices) of one error group, newest first: each with id, deploy, errors and backtrace, context (environment, hostname, app version, user, URL, severity, notifier), environment, session and request params, and created time. Optionally only notices of one app version. Backtraces are cut to the first 10 frames unless full_backtraces is set. Airbrake API: GET /api/v4/projects/{project_id}/groups/{group_id}/notices.

group_id.description: Error group id (digits, as a string: Airbrake group ids exceed JavaScript's safe integers). From airbrake_list_groups.

version.description: Only notices reported by this app version (e.g. 1.0).

full_backtraces.description: Return every backtrace frame (default: first 10 per error).

annotations.title: List notices of an error group

tools.name: airbrake_get_notice_status
tools.title: Get a notice's processing status
tools.description: Check what happened to a reported error, by the notice id that Airbrake's create-notice API returned: code = processed (groupId = its error group), rejected (message = why, e.g. an app-version filter), archived (past retention) or not_found (unknown or still processing). Airbrake API: GET /api/v4/projects/{project_id}/notice-status/{notice_id}.

notice_id.description: The notice id returned by Airbrake's create-notice API (v3) when the error was reported.

tools.name: airbrake_list_deploys
tools.title: List deploys
tools.description: List a project's tracked deploys: environment, username/email of the deployer, repository, revision (commit) and version. Use it to correlate new errors with a release. Airbrake API: GET /api/v4/projects/{project_id}/deploys.

tools.name: airbrake_get_deploy
tools.title: Get a deploy
tools.description: Get one deploy: environment, deployer, repository, revision and version. Airbrake API: GET /api/v4/projects/{project_id}/deploys/{deploy_id}.

deploy_id.description: Deploy id (digits, as a string). From airbrake_list_deploys or a group's lastDeployId.

tools.name: airbrake_list_activities
tools.title: List project activity
tools.description: List a project's activity feed: who did what and when (for example group.resolved), with user name, activity, the affected object (trackableType/trackableId) and timestamps. Airbrake API: GET /api/v4/projects/{project_id}/activities.

tools.name: airbrake_get_project_stats
tools.title: Get project statistics
tools.description: Error volume over time for a whole project: parallel arrays `time`, `accepted` (notices counted), `limited` (dropped by rate limits) and `overQuota` (dropped over the plan quota), aggregated per period (1m, 5m, 15m, 30m, 2h, 3h, 6h, 12h, 24h). Airbrake API: GET /api/v5/projects/{project_id}/stats.

period.description: Aggregation period. The reference lists 1m, 5m, 15m, 30m, 2h, 3h, 6h, 12h, 24h (project stats) and minute, hour (group stats).

since.description: Start (inclusive), RFC 3339 date-time with timezone; sent as time__gte in Unix seconds.

tools.name: airbrake_mute_group
tools.title: Mute an error group
tools.description: WRITE: mute one error group. Airbrake removes it from the default error list and stops ALL notifications for it (email, Slack and other integrations) until it is unmuted. Notices are still recorded. Reversible with airbrake_unmute_group. Airbrake API: PUT /api/v4/projects/{project_id}/groups/{group_id}/muted.

group_id.description: Error group id (digits, as a string: Airbrake group ids exceed JavaScript's safe integers). From airbrake_list_groups.

tools.name: airbrake_unmute_group
tools.title: Unmute an error group
tools.description: WRITE: unmute one error group, so it is back in the default error list and its notifications resume. Airbrake API: PUT /api/v4/projects/{project_id}/groups/{group_id}/unmuted.

group_id.description: Error group id (digits, as a string: Airbrake group ids exceed JavaScript's safe integers). From airbrake_list_groups.
